I am a bit confused on what you mean exactly with the first part. if you are saying that we already have a way to load a map file/game file then i think that is wrong. we have a way to load it in a testing environment but the end goal described is not that. the current approach doesnt do anything the same as it was discussed in the decision file. or am i getting ahead of myself and misunderstanding what you wrote here because i can see you started to then state the following build setup 

as for the questions 
1 : ya none of it exists so establish it, you can take the same principle from the smith compiler and its bless system
2: looks fine, doesnt really matter to me much, just something coherent.
3: do whatever is the most performant and doesnt corrupt
4: is this a question or a statement ? xD
resolution: Clarified the §1a confusion in PLATMOD_PLAN.md and folded in all four rulings. §1a now states unmistakably that NOTHING loads a map/game file today — no lump container, binary RLE, package, content store, or player boot exists; the table is the parts bin (host bones to build into), not a claim the goal works; the only current loading is the localstore testing channel. Rulings recorded in §3+§6: (1) channel discipline established on the Smith bless principle — bleeding/blessed, human-only promotion, build+verify gate, stamp with shas; (2) package naming stands, coherence the only bar; (3) content store = own content-addressed dir, atomic temp+fsync+rename writes, hash-verified on install (most performant, corruption-checked by construction); (4) was a real question — answered and pinned: Compile dual-writes the boot key until the §5 done-bar passes, retirement then scheduled like any route flip on the user's word. Doc edited on disk only; commit awaits supervisor order.
